description: Place an image or other file at x, y on an artboard, linked or embedded (File > Place): PNG, JPEG, JPEG 2000, TIFF, PSD, GIF, BMP, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, TGA, PCX, PXR, PDF (a chosen page), EPS and DCS, SVG/SVGZ, AI, AutoCAD DWG/DXF, CGM, CorelDRAW, EMF/WMF. Give width to scale it proportionally. Text files go through place_text_file

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

autocad.description: DWG and DXF files only (the DXF/DWG Options dialog)

center.description: Centre the artwork on the artboard. Default true

layout.description: Name of the drawing layout to import. Default the model layout

mergeLayers.description: Merge the drawing's layers into one. Default false

scaleLineweights.description: Scale line weights with the drawing. Default false

scalePercent.description: With scale by_value: the scale to apply

unit.description: Unit drawing units map to. Default millimeters

unitRatio.description: How many of unit one drawing unit equals. Default 1

embed.description: Embed instead of linking. Default false

pdf.description: PDF files only (the PDF Import Options dialog)

cropTo.description: Which PDF box bounds the artwork: bounding, art, crop, trim, bleed or media (default)

page.description: The page to open or place, 1-based. Default 1

width.description: Scale proportionally to this width in points

name: place_image
title: Place Image
